about_the_game:
When an ancient corruption takes hold in a fantastical world ruled by celtic-inspired deities, The Fianna, an order of legendary heroes, must rise again to restore peace.

GAMEPLAY

Fianna is an indie action roguelite with fast-paced combat. As a new member of the Fianna, you must lead a group of 3 soldiers into a randomly generated dungeon. Fight through multiple areas of handcrafted rooms and find relics and ancient knowledge in order to power up. You must vanquish powerful bosses, but will you be able to defeat War itself?

VIBES AND STORY

Enjoy a fantasy pixel art aesthetic, complete with interesting and unique characters who will be able to talk after fighting alongside each other. Perhaps these conversations will also facilitate a transfer of knowledge?

FEATURES

  • 100+ items to find on your journey

  • 6 Characters, complete with unique item pools and movesets

  • Interesting and unique combat

  • Teambuilding

  • Destructible terrain, which may drop rewards

  • Shops to spend precious silver

  • An abundance of enemies and bosses to crush you

  • Team conversations. The Fianna may gain relationship points with each other, allowing them to learn unique moves that take inspiration from their teammates

  • Hours and hours of gameplay!

  • Free updates
